name: track_then_log
title: First day · "track what I eat" gets a table at once, and "log two eggs" a row

steps.reply:
I've set up a **Food log** for you. Each entry has what you ate, when, which meal, how much, and calories, protein, carbs and fat. There's also a **Calories per day** chart.

To log something, just tell me in plain words, like "two eggs and toast for breakfast" or "had a latte at 3". I'll fill in the time and meal. If you don't give me the nutrition numbers, I'll estimate them from standard food data and mark them as estimates, so you can always tell them apart from numbers you gave me.

Do you have a daily calorie or protein target? If you tell me, I can show how each day measures up.

I've logged 2 eggs for breakfast this morning (10:38): about **144 kcal**, 12.6 g protein, 0.8 g carbs and 9.5 g fat.

The numbers are USDA values for large eggs, and I assumed they were cooked without butter or oil. If you used fat or they were a different size, tell me and I'll change the entry.
